summary: Toyota Motor filed a 6-K attaching Tokyo Stock Exchange disclosures, including a notice amending prior resolutions on share repurchases, a tender offer for its own shares, and retirement of treasury shares, alongside Q2 FY2027 results and organizational/executive changes effective January 1, 2027. No price per share, stake, premium or timetable is specified in the excerpt. The buyback and self-tender mechanics signal a capital-return program; amended repurchase and treasury-retirement terms warrant review. Watch the tender's pricing range, acceptance conditions and any cross-shareholding tender commitments as the risk-arb angle.
